UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd screeps && NodeVersion=\"v$(wget -qO- https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/nodejs/releases/24 | jq -r \".result.latest.name\")\"; if [[ ! \"$NodeVersion\" =~ ^v24\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then if [[ -x node/bin/node ]]; then echo \"Could not check for a newer Node.js 24 release. Keeping $(node/bin/node --version)\" && exit 0; fi; echo \"Could not get the latest Node.js 24 version. Aborting\" && exit 1; fi; if [[ -x node/bin/node && \"$(node/bin/node --version)\" == \"$NodeVersion\" ]]; then echo \"Node.js $NodeVersion already installed. Skipping\"; else rm -f node.tar.gz; wget -qO node.tar.gz https://nodejs.org/download/release/$NodeVersion/node-$NodeVersion-linux-x64.tar.gz || { echo \"Download failed from the Node.js CDN. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf node && mkdir -p node && tar -xzf node.tar.gz -C node --strip-components=1 && rm -f node.tar.gz && echo \"Node.js $NodeVersion installed\"; fi"

-c "cd screeps/server && export PATH=\"$(cd ../node/bin && pwd):$PATH\" && { [ -f package.json ] || echo '{\"name\":\"screeps-server\",\"version\":\"1.0.0\",\"private\":true}' > package.json; } && npm install --no-fund --no-audit screeps@latest {{Mods}}"

-c "cd screeps && if [ ! -f world/.screepsrc ]; then mkdir -p world && cp -r server/node_modules/@screeps/launcher/init_dist/. world/ && sed -i \"s/^steam_api_key = .*/steam_api_key =/\" world/.screepsrc && echo \"World data created\"; else echo \"Existing world data found. Skipping\"; fi"
